reason: Builds auditable knowledge packs from local documents and provides deterministic full-text retrieval and original-text reading through kb_build, kb_query, and kb_read.

summaries.zh: 将本地 Markdown、文本、DOCX 和 PDF 文档构建为可审计知识包，并提供确定性的全文检索与原文阅读工具。
summaries.en: Builds auditable knowledge packs from local Markdown, text, DOCX, and PDF documents and provides deterministic full-text search and original-text reading tools.

capabilities: Reads local md, txt, docx, and pdf documents
Extracts and indexes document text into SQLite FTS5 knowledge packs
Writes generated skill files, references, metadata, and database files
Performs deterministic local search and original-text reading
